label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 236 ]

blocks.text: When you clean out your storage room, don’t throw out any “junk”
until you determine its potential as a collectible.In fact, what often
appears to be a piece of worthless old junk may very well be quite
valuable. For instance, people often sell old record albums, bottles and
books for pennies only to see them resold for tens or hundreds of
dollars as parts of larger collections. Rarer cases involve people selling
paintings that were actually painted by famous painters.Therefore,
before you have a garage sale, call an antique dealer to help you
separate the valuable from the worthless junk.

readingSentences.english: Music education fosters cognitive development and emotional discipline in children.
readingSentences.korean: 음악 교육은 어린이의 인지 발달과 정서적 자기 훈련을 촉진한다.

readingSentences.english: Learning to play an instrument teaches patience, fine motor coordination, and focus.
readingSentences.korean: 악기를 배우는 것은 인내심, 정교한 운동 협응력, 그리고 집중력을 길러준다.

readingSentences.english: Practicing regularly instills a strong sense of personal responsibility and accomplishment.
readingSentences.korean: 규칙적인 연습은 강한 개인적 책임감과 성취감을 심어준다.

readingSentences.english: Every child deserves access to artistic training regardless of background.
readingSentences.korean: 모든 어린이는 배경에 상관없이 예술 교육을 받을 자격이 있다.
